instruction.text: Übersetze die Sätze, indem du das fehlende englische Wort auswählst.

atoms.a: Ich möchte mir London in einem Doppeldeckerbus ansehen.
atoms.b: I would like to see London by ((++double-decker_bus train tram ferry tube bike plane)).
atoms.sound: I would like to see London by double-decker bus.

atoms.a: Was kostet eine Fahrt mit dem Zug nach Manchester?
atoms.b: How much does it cost to go to Manchester by ((double-decker_bus ++train tram ferry tube bike plane)) ?
atoms.sound: How much does it cost to go to Manchester by train?

atoms.b: Where is the nearest ((double-decker_bus train ++tram ferry tube bike plane)) stop?
atoms.sound: Where is the nearest tram stop?

atoms.a: Ich habe zwei Stunden auf die Fähre gewartet.
atoms.b: I've waited two hours for the ((double-decker_bus train tram ++ferry tube bike plane)).
atoms.sound: I've waited two hours for the ferry.

atoms.a: Ich fahre immer mit der Londoner U-Bahn zur Schule.
atoms.b: I always go to school on the ((double-decker_bus train tram ferry ++tube bike plane)).
atoms.sound: I always go to school on the tube.

atoms.a: Willst du mit dem Fahrrad zum Buckingham Palace fahren?
atoms.b: Do you want to go to Buckingham Palace by ((double-decker_bus train tram ferry tube ++bike plane))?
atoms.sound: Do you want to go to Buckingham Palace by bike

atoms.a: Ich fliege morgen mit dem Flugzeug nach London.
atoms.b: Tomorrow I'm going to London by ((double-decker_bus train tram ferry tube bike ++plane)).
atoms.sound: Tomorrow I'm going to London by ((plane)).

instruction.text: Entscheide, ob die Aussage wahr oder falsch ist.

atoms.a: The tube goes under the ground.
Cars drive on the railway track.

atoms.a: Trains go on the railway track.
